author: potatoarmor
body:
What he does is chooses kit fireman then immediately kills his teammates to take their stuff.

Here is a picture of one of his kills:

http://i.imgur.com/x6BV8Tr.jpg

Ebram140334 died immediately after this screenshot.  This was the second team kill for rilomilo9 in less than a minute - after ebram140334 died there were no more teammates to kill.  And he was temp-banned earlier tonight for team killing (the ban wore off), his second ban for team killing.

I've seen rilomilo9 do this in at least four Walls games including one where I was killed but only watched the one game tonight (where he killed both teammates in under a minute).  I reported him of course but either no mods were available or they came too late, rilomilo9 does it quickly.
